errors.evidence: The figure caption states the data is for "Р. България" (Republic of Bulgaria), not for the "българската минна индустрия" (Bulgarian mining industry), which was likely taken from the paper's title instead of the figure's own labels.

errors.text_span: Останаа Y представляват БВП на един отработен човек на час, изчислени на база на текущите цени от 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis represents "лева/човекочас" (BGN/person-hour). The description incorrectly conflates the axis label with the descriptions of the two different data series from the legend (one is at current prices, the other at 2015 prices).

errors.text_span: Скалата на оста Y достига до 18.94 от 9.95, с интервали от 1.00.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 20, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 2. The description incorrectly states the range using data point values and reports the wrong interval.

The description fails to state what each line represents according to the legend. It omits that the blue line is "БВП на един отработен човекочас по текущи цени" (GDP per hour worked at current prices) and the orange line is "БВП на един отработен човекочас по цени на 2015 г." (GDP per hour worked at 2015 prices).
The blue line's value in 2018 is 18.94. The value 16.71 corresponds to the blue line's value in 2016.
The description omits that the blue line is a dashed line.
The term "стоманообразуващ" (steel-forming) is nonsensical in this context and represents subjective, interpretive language, violating the requirement for neutral, technical description.

errors.text_span: започва при стойност от 6.4 през 2000 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line starts at the value 9.95 in the year 2000, not 6.4. The value 6.4 corresponds to the blue line in 2002.
The description omits that the orange line is a solid line.
